about_the_game:
Slay your enemies in style with our exclusive new Wardrobe Expansion, featuring brand-new designs from the Rug Reader herself. Channel your inner motivational speaker with the empowering Death Set or dazzle your foes with the radiant shimmer of the Crystal Set. Either way, you’ll look like royalty - because do you really want to face Mare looking like that, dear?

Includes two new outfit sets for Aleksandra and Fortune:

- Death Set
- Crystal Set
